subject: Fix POST /guidance pausing loops on review-severity items
description: Follow-up bug from the severity-tier work, found during triage-UI verification: POST /guidance in daemon.js (~line 1299) sets L.active=false on every loop unconditionally when a guidance item is created. Per the tier semantics (task e0c18996.../3), severity:'review' items must queue WITHOUT pausing anything — only 'blocking' items should deactivate loops. Guard the loop-deactivation with the item's effective severity (absent → 'blocking', matching addGuidance's default). Requires daemon restart (backup first, verify /health after). Verify: POST a throwaway severity:'review' item while a loop is active → loop stays active; POST a blocking one → loop deactivates; clean up both test items via /guidance/resolve.
